==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. My UFO tries to remove Ruby Wielder's symbiote with a tractor beam. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (My Ghostly UFO resembles a ghostly flying saucer with an ethereal green glow.) (For some reason I called my UFO Leon and it responded. I don't know how I knew its name, as I've never referred to it by name before.) (The Ruby Wielder is a flying, sparkling ruby, faceless humanoid wielding a glowing, magical, ruby trident.)
Ruby Wielder anchors themselves by stabbing their trident into the ground.
The tractor beam succeeds at removing the symbiote and the wielder collapses as a being of black stone. (With the symbiote removed the wielder and the trident both seemed to resemble black stone. It may be possible that the wielder was always a golem, which makes sense. Golems are often created to protect, but can go rogue. Especially if they're possessed by a corruptive symbiote.)
